source: Five user photographs of the Passaporte para Português glossary: pages 136, 138, 140, 142 and 144, including readable following-page fragments
normalization_notes: Manually transcribe pages 136, 138, 140, 142 and 144 and readable following-page fragments. Page 136 is identified from its position between previously imported pages 135 and 137; its printed number is obscured.
Exclude running publisher text, headings and page numbers. Printed references identify book sections, not CEFR levels.
Use lowercase NFC individual words; remove punctuation and trailing gender articles. Retain articles/prepositions within expressions.
Expand Exmos. as excelentíssimos, with dictionary verification. Do not insert the punctuation-bearing abbreviation as a word.
Expand loiro/louro, loiça/louça and meu/minha into separate word forms; o/a annotations on fã and fadista do not imply distinct spellings.
Split importar-se and mudar-se into base verb plus se. Retain original pronominal constructions for context.
Expand faz/por favor into faz, por and favor. Keep the lexical compound mal-educado intact.
Translate each component independently. Keep complete source expressions and the photographed German meanings in rows.
Repeated meanings such as metro (transport/measurement), ligar and mulher share one normalized word while their source occurrences remain distinct.
Deduplicate overlaps with earlier batches. Do not infer cropped rows below the page edge.
